items.title: Mirror upstream gate-actor policy in authority-client and command-policy
items.context: Update packages/main/src/core/authority-client.ts and packages/main/src/core/command-policy.ts so the CLI mirrors the upstream Authority server contract, removes stale mac_ui wording from the gate path, and keeps fail-closed behavior without widening the allowed role set.

happy.desc: Valid gate-capable inputs still produce signed job-create envelopes and completions as before.

edge.desc: Failure reasons no longer mention mac_ui after the wording cleanup.

adversarial.desc: The CLI does not fall back to a wider role set when the Mac-specific wording is removed.

items.userSees: ✓ CLI gate wording now matches the upstream Authority contract.

items.title: Sync CLI docs and contract decisions
items.context: Update the CLI-facing decision docs that still promise main/mac_ui gate roles so they match the upstream contract and keep the project/session binding story intact without adding environment tiers.

happy.desc: CLI docs describe the same neutral gate vocabulary as the server contract.

edge.desc: The docs keep the project/session binding story intact and do not add new environment tiers.

adversarial.desc: No CLI doc still implies that mac_ui is a live client surface after the cleanup.

items.userSees: ✓ CLI docs no longer promise mac_ui gate support.

items.title: Add smoke coverage for the cleaned wording
items.context: Add or adjust smoke coverage so the job-create gate path still fails closed without a valid gate actor, but the reason text no longer names mac_ui.

happy.desc: Smokes continue to show successful job-create and completion behavior for valid inputs.

edge.desc: Stale or missing gate-capable inputs still fail closed with a neutral reason.

adversarial.desc: The regression suite prevents the old mac_ui wording from coming back in the CLI path.

items.userSees: ✓ smoke coverage keeps fail-closed behavior and removes the old mac_ui wording.
